purpose: Proportionate, reproducible security, privacy, dependency, and release-trust evidence for the current static local-first public client. This gate does not claim Gate 5 completion, live release, or overall production readiness.
gate5_boundary: Gate 5 remains external VERIFY; no Gate-5 work branch is incorporated. If a later Gate-5 integration changes client, runtime, dependency, or workflow surfaces, rerun this gate before Gate 8 certification.

candidate_binding.strategy: The gate records git rev-parse HEAD, verifies an optional requested revision, records SHA-256 hashes of the contract, canonical pipeline, renderer, workflows, requirements, and material vendored files, and rejects stale public/package provenance.
candidate_binding.release_rule: A public or package artifact is eligible only when its embedded qualification/provenance tested_sha equals the exact candidate head and the security evidence is regenerated for that head.

runtime_data_flows.client_model: Static generated browser application; local-first Smart map; no account, backend, server-side session, intentional telemetry, analytics, fingerprinting, background POST, or data-upload service.
local_inputs: Generated canonical trip data, translations, cached route geometry, local photo derivatives, local PMTiles, local glyphs/sprites, and vendored JavaScript/CSS.
User-controlled browser UI events and bounded localStorage preferences.

external_origins.purpose: Optional user-selected Esri World Imagery tile and health/viewport probes.
external_origins.data_sent: Only public map tile coordinates and a bounded probe marker; no credentials or user state.
external_origins.activation: User selects Satellite; Smart map does not contact this origin.
external_origins.failure: Probe/tile failure returns to local Smart map and preserves planning state.
external_origins.referrer: Document meta referrer policy is no-referrer; image probes also set referrerPolicy=no-referrer.

external_origins.purpose: User-triggered Google Maps directions link for a canonical public place.
external_origins.data_sent: Only canonical public geographic place context in the query parameter.
external_origins.activation: Explicit user click on a rendered directions link.
external_origins.referrer: The link uses noopener noreferrer and the document no-referrer policy.

trip_visualizer_runtime_v1.retention: Until the user or browser clears localStorage; never transmitted by the application.

external_url_policy.google_navigation_query: api=1 plus a canonical public query; no credentials, fragment, or arbitrary origin

document_referrer_policy.scope: Standalone, modular, and public HTML; response headers remain host-controlled.

static_controls.mixed_content: No intentional HTTP runtime endpoint; external runtime provider and navigation are HTTPS-only.

csp.reason: GitHub Pages cannot set a response CSP from this repository. A compatible meta CSP would need to permit generated inline data/scripts and standalone data/blob assets; adding a nominal policy that requires unsafe-inline or breaks file delivery would not be a security improvement.
csp.limitation: A host-level CSP header remains an operator/deployment control and is not claimed by this gate.

static_controls.iframe_object_embed: No maintained runtime use; scanner fails on new iframe/object/embed tags.
static_controls.workers_blob_data: No runtime worker; data/blob are used only for standalone/local PMTiles and locally embedded assets as documented.

pages.qualification: pipeline.py release --revision github.sha then verify-public --revision github.sha
pages.untrusted_candidate_path: No candidate branch can invoke this workflow or receive Pages/OIDC authority.

forbidden_patterns: direct Pages mutation outside canonical pipeline
workflow command injection from untrusted output

dependency_update_policy.reviewed_update_procedure: Update one dependency or action at a time; obtain upstream release/advisory/license evidence; update exact version/source/hash and this contract; regenerate vendor provenance; run focused tests, pipeline fast, exact candidate qualification, and public/package verification.
dependency_update_policy.runtime_vendor_policy: Runtime JavaScript and CSS remain local and hash-bound; no CDN replacement is permitted.
dependency_update_policy.python_policy: QA dependencies and their resolved transitive closure are exact-version and hash-pinned; pip is not upgraded during release.
dependency_update_policy.action_policy: Third-party Actions use full commit SHAs with human-readable upstream version comments.

dependency_inventory.role: local charting dependency retained by the generated client

dependency_inventory.origin: locally bundled fflate, PMTiles, and @protomaps/basemaps modules
dependency_inventory.role: local PMTiles protocol, archive reader, and vector style layers
critical Smart map data; no runtime remote replacement

dependency_inventory.origin: PyPI artifacts selected for Python 3.11 QA runner; hashes are recorded in requirements-qa.txt

dependency_inventory.version: Playwright 1.62.0 browser bundle selected by the pinned package
dependency_inventory.immutable_boundary: Browser archives are platform-provided by Playwright's exact package release; this repository does not redistribute them or claim an artifact hash.

advisory_review.method: Review exact pinned package versions against authoritative project/PyPI/GitHub advisory sources available during qualification; do not claim a universal clean bill when a source or bundle identity is ambiguous.

reviewed.result: Selected over the old 2.31.0 pin; this exact build includes the 2.32 certificate/netrc fixes and the upstream 2.33 fix for GHSA-gc5v-m9x4-r6x2 / CVE-2026-25645. The repository uses Requests only in build-time acquisition helpers and does not call extract_zipped_paths().
Vendored artifact and upstream release identity are exact; runtime exposure remains local.
Vendored artifact and upstream release identity are exact; no runtime network acquisition.

verify_required: Authoritative advisory coverage for the exact embedded fflate/PMTiles/@protomaps/basemaps versions is VERIFY_REQUIRED because the bundle does not embed semver and no lockfile is present.
Playwright browser archives are platform-provided by the exact package release; browser archive provenance is VERIFY_REQUIRED beyond the package pin.

gate_checks.secret_scan: Tracked production inputs and exact generated build/public/package artifacts; findings are path/classification only and values are redacted.
gate_checks.injection: Runtime shared escaping, local-photo path validation, provider URL validation, and Google Maps origin/path validation; adversarial browser fixture required.
gate_checks.vendor_drift: Every shipped vendor file in the inventory is SHA-256 checked before evidence can pass.
gate_checks.public_exposure: Generated public/package trees reject private paths, credential patterns, environment dumps, browser profiles, scratch data, and unapproved runtime origins.
gate_checks.rights_and_resilience: Gate 6 public-asset rights and Gate 4 local-first/provider recovery remain canonical prerequisites.

limitations: GitHub Pages response headers are host-controlled; this repository can enforce a document referrer meta policy but cannot claim an HTTP CSP header.
Optional Esri Satellite remains externally dependent and may be VERIFY_REQUIRED when the provider cannot be reached; Smart-map qualification is network-independent.
Gate 5 remains external VERIFY and is not certified by this contract.
The contract records exact bundle hashes for the embedded trip-vector components, but their individual semvers require a later provenance refresh from the original JS dependency lock/source build.
